senses.zh_definition: Meenamma：有文献记录的人名，中文可暂音译为“米娜玛”；尚未核实其作为马来语普通词的词义。
senses.en_definition: Meenamma, an attested personal name; its status as a Malay common word is unverified.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang yang dieja Meenamma; makna sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu belum dapat disahkan.
senses.nuances: 此处按专有名词处理，正文写作 Meenamma。1957 年锡兰政府公报记录了该人名，见 [Ceylon Government Gazette](https://diglib.natlib.lk/bitstream/handle/123456789/36553/046_CEYLON%20GOVERNMENT%20GAZETTE_1957-JULY-AUGUST_11157_I_SEC_I_16-08-1957_E.pdf?isAllowed=y&sequence=3)。以上马来语释义为编辑说明，并非 DBP 官方释义。输入序位 10737 仅按数据包保留，未经独立词频验证。以下组合及例句为原创用法示例，未取得高频搭配证据。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场汇报；以 Meenamma 为人名的原创示例

dual_scenarios.en: Ms Meenamma will present the project progress report at tomorrow's meeting.

etymology.historical_story: Meenamma appears as a personal name in a 1957 Ceylon government gazette, providing a historical anchor for this spelling. It also occurs as a Tamil song title in Raaga’s catalogue. These records document its circulation in names and cultural works; the available evidence leaves its precise etymology and any adoption into Malay unresolved. Sources: [Government Gazette](https://diglib.natlib.lk/bitstream/handle/123456789/36553/046_CEYLON%20GOVERNMENT%20GAZETTE_1957-JULY-AUGUST_11157_I_SEC_I_16-08-1957_E.pdf?isAllowed=y&sequence=3), [Raaga catalogue](https://www.raaga.com/tamil/songs/meenamma-249199).
